Officer's narrative
Responding to a report of a two-vehicle collision at an intersection in Houston, Texas, I found that Driver 1 was
making a left turn when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported
back strain following the impact. The nature and focre of the collision are consistent with that type of injury. A
Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officers and the statements taken at the scene
confirm that Driver 1 was present in the vehicle at the time. No independent witnesses were located. Scene
photographs show the damage and confirm several details provided by the drivers. The visible damage is largely
consistent with the impact described. Nothing in the vehicle's condition or the records reviewed suggests earlier
damage. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the
scene, and the drivers exchanged information before leaving.
</page>
